explanation: Read-only SQL over the verified BDC panel.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_debt = 1 THEN 'Debt' ELSE 'Equity' END AS investment_kind, COUNT(*) AS holdings, ROUND(SUM(fair_value), 2) AS total_fair_value, ROUND(AVG(fair_value), 2) AS average_fair_value FROM holdings_v GROUP BY is_debt ORDER BY is_debt DESC
